profiles.label: Acute one-night sleep restriction, 2-6 h sleep opportunity

trigger.required_context: single-night restriction or closest available proxy

judgment.detail: Meta-analysis did not find a uniform significant pooled effect for working memory or inhibitory control; do not convert this to zero impairment.

operation.detail: Operational caution is inferred only for tasks that depend heavily on sustained attention/reaction; no percent-capacity conversion is claimed.

source.title: Impact of one night of sleep restriction on sleepiness and cognitive function: A systematic review and meta-analysis

judgment.detail: Reference study primarily measured psychomotor vigilance rather than broad judgment.

operation.detail: Use only as a vigilance-sensitive operational prior; protocol does not justify a universal productivity percentage.

source.title: Patterns of performance degradation and restoration during sleep restriction and subsequent recovery: a sleep dose-response study

judgment.detail: Do not generalize speed/accuracy equivalence to all judgment domains.

reaction.detail: Some response-speed measures were up to 50% slower in the reference study.

accuracy.detail: Accuracy measures were significantly poorer on some tests.

operation.detail: Relevant to speed-and-accuracy dependent safety/industrial tasks in the studied context.

comparative_reference.semantics: some cognitive/motor test performance equivalent or worse
comparative_reference.not: hangover equivalence or a universal impairment conversion

source.title: Moderate sleep deprivation produces impairments in cognitive and motor performance equivalent to legally prescribed levels of alcohol intoxication
